skills.description: Preprocesses structural MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR) and chooses the right pipeline for the downstream question. This skill should be used when the user needs reorientation, bias field correction (N4), skull stripping (SynthStrip, HD-BET, BET), registration to MNI or between modalities (ANTs, FSL), intensity normalization, tissue segmentation, cortical reconstruction (FreeSurfer, FastSurfer), VBM (CAT12), or longitudinal processing. Triggers: T1 preprocessing, skull strip, brain extraction, N4, ANTs, FLIRT, FNIRT, SyN, MNI registration, recon-all, FastSurfer, SynthSeg, CAT12, sMRIPrep, cortical thickness.
skills.description_zh: 对结构性MRI（T1w、T2w、FLAIR）进行预处理，并为下游问题选择正确的流程。当用户需要进行重定向、偏置场校正（N4）、颅骨剥离（SynthStrip、HD-BET、BET）、配准到MNI或模态间配准（ANTs、FSL）、强度归一化、组织分割、皮层重建（FreeSurfer、FastSurfer）、VBM（CAT12）或纵向处理时，应使用此技能。触发词：T1 preprocessing、skull strip、brain extraction、N4、ANTs、FLIRT、FNIRT、SyN、MNI registration、recon-all、FastSurfer、SynthSeg、CAT12、sMRIPrep、cortical thickness。
